description: This is a JUnit test class for the Minus operation in a calculator project, testing the perform and getName methods of the Minus class.

classes.name: MinusTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the Minus operation, extending AbstractOperationTest and testing the behavior of the Minus class.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the BinaryOperation instance with a Minus object before each test.

methods.name: testPerform
methods.description: Tests that the perform method correctly computes the subtraction, expecting -1.0 when subtracting 2.0 from 1.0.

methods.name: testGetName
methods.description: Tests that the getName method of the operation returns the string '-'.
